title: How Many Quickest Routes
statement:
A city has `n` junctions and `m` two-way roads. Count the shortest routes from junction `1` to junction `n`, where length means the number of roads. Two routes are different if they pass through different roads or junctions in order. Print the count modulo `1000000007`.

If junction `n` cannot be reached, print `0`. If `n = 1`, there is exactly one route (the empty one).

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains the two junctions joined by a road. No road is listed twice.

## Output
Print the number of shortest routes modulo `1000000007`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- `0 <= m <= 15000`
